tools.name: adintel_get_creatives

media type. Max 30 days of data allowed per request. Uses the unique trackId from
iTunes Connect / Play Store (e.g. Facebook iOS: 284882215, Android: com.facebook.katana).

track_id.description: Track id of the app.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

track_id.description: Track id of the app.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: adintel_network_distribution

track_id.description: Track id of the app.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

track_id.description: Application track id.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

category, description, screenshots, ratings, available countries).

Credit cost: 5 credits per request.

track_id.description: AppStore track id of the app.

country_code.description:
Optional two letter country code of the app. Defaults to the
primary country of the app if not provided.

tools.name: appstore_app_simple_information
tools.description:
Provides simplified information for given apps in AppStore (name, developer,
price, icon, category, rating, last update).

Credit cost: 1 credits per request.

country_code.description: Two letter country code of the apps.

track_ids.description:
Comma separated list of AppStore track ids of apps. Max. 10 apps

tools.name: appstore_app_version_list
tools.description:

release notes and a list of which app properties changed in each version.

Credit cost: 1 credits per request.

track_id.description: AppStore track id of the app.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD formatted date, history start date, inclusive.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD formatted date, history end date, exclusive.

Credit cost: 50 credits per request.

track_id.description: AppStore track id of the app.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD formatted date, history start date, inclusive.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD formatted date, history end date, exclusive.

tools.name: appstore_developer_apps
tools.description:
Provides a list of apps owned by the given developer in the given country.

tools.name: appstore_app_discovery
tools.description:
Queues the given App Store app for discovery. Returns a boolean value for
confirmation.

Credit cost: 1 credits per request.

track_id.description: App Store track id of the app.

tools.name: appstore_app_reviews
tools.description:
Provides the review list of an app in AppStore. If the app is not crawled it
flags the app for crawling and returns an empty list.

Credit cost: 5 credits per request.

track_id.description: AppStore track id of the app.

start_date.description: Start date for the reviews to be listed, format: "yyyy-MM-dd".

end_date.description: End date for the reviews to be listed, format: "yyyy-MM-dd".

rating.description:
Optional rating star count(s) for the reviews to be listed. Value
must be between 1-5, e.g. "3" or "1,5".

countries.description:
Optional two letter country code(s) the reviews were posted from.
Must be comma separated if more than one is provided.

text_query.description: Optional word to be searched in the reviews.

page.description:
Optional page number to iterate; a maximum of 100 reviews are returned
per request. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: appstore_app_reviews_v2
tools.description:
Provides the paginated review list of an app in AppStore, including totals for
elements and pages. If the app is not crawled it flags the app for crawling and
returns an empty list.

Credit cost: 5 credits per request.

track_id.description: AppStore track id of the app.

start_date.description: Start date for the reviews to be listed, format: "yyyy-MM-dd".

end_date.description: End date for the reviews to be listed, format: "yyyy-MM-dd".

rating.description:
Optional rating star count(s) for the reviews to be listed. Value
must be between 1-5, e.g. "3" or "1,5".

countries.description:
Optional two letter country code(s) the reviews were posted from.
Must be comma separated if more than one is provided.

text_query.description: Optional word to be searched in the reviews.

replied_review.description:
Optional boolean; true gets replied reviews, false gets
unreplied reviews. Defaults to null which gets all reviews.

page.description: Optional parameter to get the next page. Defaults to 0.

size.description:
Optional page size; a maximum of 100 reviews are returned per request.
Defaults to 20.

tools.name: appstore_app_review_analysis
tools.description:
Provides word based analysis for the reviews of a given app (word frequency,
average rating, sentiment distribution, trend). Max. 30 days of data allowed for
a single request.

Credit cost: 10 credits per request.

track_id.description: AppStore track id of the app.

start_date.description: Start date for the reviews to be analyzed, format: "yyyy-MM-dd".

end_date.description: End date for the reviews to be analyzed, format: "yyyy-MM-dd".

rating.description:
Optional rating star count(s) for the reviews to be analyzed. Value
must be between 1-5, e.g. "3" or "1,5".

countries.description:
Optional two letter country code(s) the reviews were posted from.
Must be comma separated if more than one is provided.

text_query.description: Optional word to be searched in the reviews.

tools.name: appstore_download_revenue_estimations
tools.description:
Provides daily download-revenue estimations of an app in AppStore. Max 30 days
of history is allowed for a single request.

Credit cost: 100 credits per request.

track_id.description: AppStore track id of the app.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD formatted date, history start date, inclusive.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD formatted date, history end date, inclusive.

tools.name: appstore_monthly_global_download_revenue_estimations
tools.description:
Provides global download-revenue estimations of an app in AppStore for the
last month, with a per-country breakdown.

Credit cost: 2 credits per request.

track_id.description: AppStore track id of the app.

tools.name: appstore_featured_apps
tools.description:
Retrieves detailed information about how an application is featured within a
specific category on the App Store, including the type of feature, associated
imagery, titles, and related applications.

Credit cost: 40 credits per request.

track_id.description: App Store track id of the app.

start_date.description:
Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to
(endDate - 1 day).

end_date.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

country_code.description:
Optional 2 letter uppercase country code. Defaults to
'All Countries'.

Credit cost: 20 credits per request.

track_id.description: App Store track id of the app.

start_date.description:
Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to
(endDate - 1 day).

end_date.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

country_code.description:
Optional 2 letter uppercase country code. Defaults to
'All Countries'.

tools.description:
Provides top charts information for given category, country, ranking type and device.

Credit cost: 10 credits per request.

version.description:
"v1" for iOS 11 and before, "v2" for iOS 12+ (currently only
overall category is available).

tools.name: appstore_category_ranking
tools.description:
Provides category rankings history of an app in the App Store. Max 30 days
of history is allowed for a single request.

Credit cost: 10 credits per request.

"v1" for iOS 11 and before, "v2" for iOS 12+ (currently only
overall category is available).

track_id.description: App Store track id of the app.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD formatted date, history end date, exclusive.

page.description:
Page number for iteration; returns a maximum of 100 CPPs per request,
defaults to 0.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code; if not specified, returns for all countries.

range exceeds it, the end date is automatically set 30 days from the start date.

page.description:

country.description: Optional two-letter country code; if not specified, returns for all countries.

end_date.description:

range exceeds it, the end date is automatically set 30 days from the start date.

page.description:
Page number for iteration; returns a maximum of 100 CPPs per request,
defaults to 0.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code; if not specified, returns for all countries.

Credit cost: 200 credits per request.

track_id.description: AppStore track id of the app.

track_ids.description:

countries.description:

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: searchads_get_goal
tools.description:
Get details of a specific goal you created on SearchAds.com.

tools.name: searchads_get_bid_history_logs
tools.description:
Get logs of bid changes on SearchAds.com.

Credit cost: 20 credits per request.

start_date.description: Start date of logs in ISO date format (yyyy-MM-dd).

end_date.description:
End date of logs in ISO date format (yyyy-MM-dd). The max
allowed date range is 1 week.

tools.name: searchads_get_reports
tools.description:
Get ASA + MMP reports for different data levels.

For TOP_APPS reports use searchads_get_top_apps_report instead — that
report type requires an additional keywordList field.

Credit cost: 20 credits per request.

report_type.description:
Type of report: REPORT, DAILY or SUMMARY. For TOP_APPS
use searchads_get_top_apps_report.

report_level.description:
Level of report: ACCOUNT, APP, CAMPAIGN, AD_GROUP, AD,
CPP, KEYWORD, NEGATIVE or SEARCH_TERM.

start_date.description: Start date of reports in ISO date format (yyyy-MM-dd).

end_date.description:
End date of reports in ISO date format (yyyy-MM-dd). The max
date range is 1 month per request.

org_ids.description:
List of organization (campaign group) ids. May be omitted for
ACCOUNT and APP level reports but is required for other levels. At
most 1 orgId is allowed for CAMPAIGN, AD_GROUP, AD, CPP, KEYWORD,
NEGATIVE or SEARCH_TERM reports.

goal_id.description:
Goal id for MMP reports. Without it only ASA reports are
returned.

app_id.description:
App id for MMP (goal) reports. Required when goal_id is provided.
Without it, goal reports cannot be fetched.

re_attr_type.description:
Whether to use re-attribution data when calculating
metrics. Options: WITH, WITHOUT, ONLY. Default: WITH.

currency.description: Three letter currency code for the metrics. Default: USD.

page.description: Cursor of the report data. Default is 0.

tools.name: searchads_get_top_apps_report
tools.description:
Get a Search Ads TOP_APPS report: top advertising apps for the given
keywords. Unlike other report types, TOP_APPS requires a keywordList with
one entry per keyword.

Credit cost: 20 credits per request.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD formatted report start date, inclusive.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD formatted report end date, inclusive.

items.description: One keyword entry for a TOP_APPS report.

keyword_list.description:
Keywords to report on. Each entry requires: keyword
(text), keywordId, appId (track id of the app the keyword belongs
to), orgId (Search Ads organization id) and country (two letter
country code), e.g. {"keyword": "flowers", "keywordId": 1707347165,
"appId": 418870703, "orgId": 26320, "country": "US"}.

org_ids.description: Optional list of Search Ads organization (campaign group) ids.

report_level.description: Level of the report, defaults to KEYWORD.

page.description: Optional page cursor for paginated results.

start_date.description:

range between start_date and end_date can be at most 14 days.

end_date.description: End date of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD formatted.

tools.name: searchads_paying_apps

keyword.description: Keyword to look up paying apps for.

start_date.description:
Start date of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD formatted. The
range between start_date and end_date can be at most 14 days.

end_date.description: End date of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD formatted.
